# Vendor libraries

Self-hosted so the page loads no third-party scripts (no CDN request, nothing to declare in the privacy policy).
Update by downloading the exact version from the npm registry and replacing the file.

| File | Version | Source (npm) | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gsap.min.js` | 3.12.5 | `gsap/dist/gsap.min.js` | GSAP Standard License, https://gsap.com/standard-license |
| `ScrollTrigger.min.js` | 3.12.5 | `gsap/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js` | GSAP Standard License |
| `lenis.min.js` | 1.1.13 | `lenis/dist/lenis.min.js` | MIT, see `lenis.LICENSE.txt` |

Icons in `index.html` are an inline SVG sprite built from Font Awesome Free 6.5.0
(`@fontawesome/fontawesome-free/svgs/solid`), icons licensed CC BY 4.0, https://fontawesome.com/license/free.
